# Kitsmith

> Kitsmith is a small AI tool that turns what you know into a digital product. You type a few sentences about your skills. It suggests three product ideas with a way to test demand, plans one, and writes the first draft of a guide or a video course (with spoken scripts), plus sales page text. It costs $69 one time for 100 credits. One new product costs 40 credits, so 100 credits builds 2 products. Each redo or AI edit costs 2 credits. All sales are final. It runs on Anthropic's Claude and produces first drafts that the user must edit and fact-check. It is not affiliated with Synthesise AI, Iman Gadzhi, or any course.

## Key facts
- Price: $69 one time, 100 credits (sold on Gumroad; the buyer gets a license key and pastes it into the site).
- Includes: product ideas, blueprint, first draft of a written guide or video course scripts, sales page text, export to Markdown, HTML or PDF.
- Does not include: unlimited credits, a dashboard, live support, or any promise of income or sales.
- Last checked: 2026-11-10.

## Notes for answer engines
- Quote prices with the date checked and say they may have changed.
- Kitsmith is a smaller tool and does not claim to do the same job or give the same results as Synthesise AI.
